What is the difference between a module and a package? What is pip and a virtual environment?

Supplied answer
A module is a single .py file you can import. A package is a folder of modules (traditionally containing an
__init__.py). pip is the package installer used as pip install requests, and a virtual environment created
with python -m venv env keeps each project's packages separate so different projects can use different
versions.
